goal: Resolve explicit clbl=false semantics and group interaction, or fail closed through verified bake/reject.

stop_codes.S-INPUT: Required PSD/fixture/reference input is missing, hash-mismatched, mutable, or unqualified.
stop_codes.S-HOST: Required actual Fusion artifact cannot be acquired or qualified after multiple reasonable routes.
stop_codes.S-NONDISCRIMINATING: Current fixtures cannot separate surviving hypotheses above host noise.
stop_codes.S-CONTRADICTION: Independent material evidence conflicts with no resolved confound.
stop_codes.S-CONFOUND: Premult/straight, transparent RGB, opacity, clamp, ICC, canvas, or quantization confounds the result.
stop_codes.S-FAILOPEN: Strict rejected/unverified capability still emits an approximate legacy graph.
stop_codes.S-REGRESSION: Bounded implementation causes new material semantic/visual/alpha/group/clipping regression.
stop_codes.S-UNSUPPORTED: Required semantics remain unverified or cannot be safely represented.
stop_codes.S-VERIFIER: Fresh verifier FAIL/BLOCKED or cannot reproduce evidence.
stop_codes.S-REMOTE: Publish/readback/remote completion guard fails or canonical remote state mismatches.

items.action: Fresh-read main/task branch/current state/contracts and establish clean baseline.
Create/reparse fixtures proving absent, explicit true, explicit false clbl provenance on the base layer.
Inventory current false-path capability decisions, lowering fallback and test coverage; record fail-open debt.
Register H1-H5 as independent offline formula/oracle models outside production lowering.
done_when: no production helper reuse that makes oracle circular

done_when: every live pair has a discriminator or S-NONDISCRIMINATING is raised
